title: Host Programme Tier Thresholds — Host Accounts
content:
# Host Accounts — Programme Thresholds

The thresholds at which a Host Accounts holder moves between host programmes are published for every tier and are identical across tiers.

| Host tier | Leaving Starter Host: completed stays | Leaving Starter Host: account age | Professional Host: live listings | Professional Host Plus: live listings | Professional Host Plus: lowest average guest rating | Enterprise Partner: live listings |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Host | 3 | 90 calendar days | 11 | 25 | 4.70 stars | 100 |
| Standard Host | 3 | 90 calendar days | 11 | 25 | 4.70 stars | 100 |
| Superhost | 3 | 90 calendar days | 11 | 25 | 4.70 stars | 100 |
| Professional Host | 3 | 90 calendar days | 11 | 25 | 4.70 stars | 100 |
| Professional Host Plus | 3 | 90 calendar days | 11 | 25 | 4.70 stars | 100 |
| Enterprise Partner | 3 | 90 calendar days | 11 | 25 | 4.70 stars | 100 |

## Explanatory notes

- A live listing is a listing that is listed or snoozed.
- The Professional Host figure is the number of live listings at which an individual host moves to Professional Host.
- Both Starter Host figures are needed together: an account with 3 completed stays that is 89 days old has not reached them; an account 120 days old with 2 completed stays has not reached them either (hypothetical illustrations).
- Each threshold is a minimum; a figure equal to it reaches it (25 live listings reaches 25; a 4.70-star average reaches 4.70).
